# 2. Data sets

## D1 (indiv + host fruits)

```{r}
# 16S
ps_rare_16S_D1 <- Charge_xl_to_ps("ps_rare_16S_D1", folder_path = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_1"))

# Filter data (exclude fruits CT & pupal cases)
ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S_D1, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "Fruits_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits"))

# Rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits") 

desired_order <- c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days","Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae",  "Pupae","Daughters")

sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)


# ITS
ps_rare_ITS_D1 <- Charge_xl_to_ps("ps_rare_ITS_D1", folder_path = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_1"))

ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS_D1, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "Fruits_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits"))

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)

# Distinguish families & genus by numbering them with their corresponding cluster number
ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- fix_unknown_taxa(phyloseq_object = ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, ranks = c("Family", "Genus"))

ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1 <- fix_unknown_taxa(phyloseq_object = ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, ranks = c("Family", "Genus"))


## Export
Save_ps_as_xls(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1")) 
Save_ps_as_xls(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"))
```

#3. Bar plots (abundance)

## D1

```{r}
ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- Charge_xl_to_ps("ps_16S_rare_expe_D1", folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1")) 
ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1 <- Charge_xl_to_ps("ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1", folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1")) 

## Bar plots : SampleType x FruitType x Site 
tax_table(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)[ "Cluster_16", "Family" ] <- "Erwiniaceae"

# 16S (Family)
plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, "Bacteria", "Family", 10, ~SampleType + FruitType+FruitSite, color_16S)

plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "Daughters")) # reorder 

plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data <-
  plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Abundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

ggsave(filename = "B_Expe_SampleType_FruitType_Site_F60.jpg", plot = plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")


# ITS (Family)
tax_table(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)[ "Cluster_66", "Family" ] <- "Cladosporiaceae"
tax_table(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)[ "Cluster_66", "Order" ] <- "Cladosporiales"
tax_table(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)[ "Cluster_66", "Class" ] <- "Dothideomycetes"
tax_table(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)[ "Cluster_66", "Phylum" ] <- "Ascomycota"

plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, "Fungi", "Family", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType+FruitSite, color_ITS) 

plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "PupalCases","Daughters")) # reorder 

plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data <-
  plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Abundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

ggsave(filename = "Y_Expe_SampleType_FruitType_Site_F60.jpg", plot = plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")


# Combined plot
barPlot_combined <- 
  (plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite + labs(tag = "A. Bacteria")) /
  (plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite + labs(tag = "B. Fungi")) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1) & theme(legend.position = "right", plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

title_plot <- "Expe_SampleType_FruitType_Site_combined_F60.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1", title_plot), barPlot_combined, base_height = 26/cm(1),  base_width = 34.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```
